@@ -340,6 +346,30 @@
 
     # ---------- LLM response parsing ----------
 
+    @staticmethod
+    def _clear_false_concat_warnings(
+        warning: str | None, command_numbers: set[int]
+    ) -> str | None:
+        if not warning:
+            return warning
+        cleaned = warning
+        for command_number in command_numbers:
+            pattern = re.compile(
+                rf"(?:-\s*)?Command\s+{command_number}\s+should end with newline "
+                r"when followed by another command\.?\s*Otherwise the two commands "
+                r"will be concatenated together on the same line\.?",
+                re.IGNORECASE,
+            )
+            cleaned = pattern.sub("", cleaned)
+        cleaned = re.sub(
+            r"WARNINGS:\s*(?:-\s*)?$", "", cleaned, flags=re.IGNORECASE
+        )
+        cleaned = re.sub(r"[ \t]+\n", "\n", cleaned)
+        cleaned = cleaned.strip()
+        if cleaned in ("", "WARNINGS:", "WARNINGS"):
+            return None
+        return cleaned
+
     def parse_llm_response(self, response: str) -> LLMResponseParseResult:
         result = self._parser.parse_response(response)
         # Cap duration at 60s to match Terminus2._handle_llm_interaction
@@ -349,13 +379,32 @@
             ToolCall(keystrokes=c.keystrokes, duration_sec=min(c.duration, 60))
             for c in result.commands
         ]
+        normalized_command_numbers: set[int] = set()
+        for i in range(len(commands) - 1):

+                warning = _EMPTY_WAIT_NORMALIZED_TRIGGER
+
         return LLMResponseParseResult(
